                  [32m'export function generateSlug(title: string, excludePostId?: number): string {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  let baseSlug = title\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    .toLowerCase()\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')\n"[39m +
                  [32m"    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  \n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (!baseSlug) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    baseSlug = 'post';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  let slug = baseSlug;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  let counter = 2;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  while (true) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const row = excludePostId \n'[39m +
                  [32m"      ? db.prepare('SELECT id FROM posts WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?').get(slug, excludePostId)\n"[39m +
                  [32m"      : db.prepare('SELECT id FROM posts WHERE slug = ?').get(slug);\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    \n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (!row) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return slug;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    slug = `${baseSlug}-${counter}`;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    counter++;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'export function getPublishedPosts(tag?: string): Post[] {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  let posts: any[];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (tag) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    posts = db.prepare(`\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      SELECT p.* FROM posts p\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      JOIN post_tags pt ON p.id = pt.post_id\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      WHERE p.published = 1 AND pt.tag = ?\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    `).all(tag);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  } else {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    posts = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM posts WHERE published = 1').all();\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  return posts.map(post => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    const tagsRows = db.prepare('SELECT tag FROM post_tags WHERE post_id = ?').all(post.id) as { tag: string }[];\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    return {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      ...post,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      tags: tagsRows.map(r => r.tag)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'export function getAllPosts(): Post[] {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"  const posts = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM posts').all() as any[];\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  return posts.map(post => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    const tagsRows = db.prepare('SELECT tag FROM post_tags WHERE post_id = ?').all(post.id) as { tag: string }[];\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    return {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      ...post,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      tags: tagsRows.map(r => r.tag)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  if (!post) return null;\n'[39m +

                  [32m'    ...post,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    tags: tagsRows.map(r => r.tag)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +

                  [32m'export function createPost(data: { title: string; body: string; tags: string[]; published: number }): Post {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const slug = generateSlug(data.title);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  \n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const insertPost = db.prepare(`\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_post_tags_tag ON post_tags(tag);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'`);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'export interface Post {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  id: number;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  title: string;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  slug: string;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  body: string;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  published: number; // 0 or 1\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  tags: string[];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'export function generateSlug(title: string, excludePostId?: number): string {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  let baseSlug = title\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    .toLowerCase()\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')\n"[39m +
                  [32m"    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  \n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (!baseSlug) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    baseSlug = 'post';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  let slug = baseSlug;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  let counter = 2;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  while (true) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const row = excludePostId \n'[39m +
                  [32m"      ? db.prepare('SELECT id FROM posts WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?').get(slug, excludePostId)\n"[39m +
                  [32m"      : db.prepare('SELECT id FROM posts WHERE slug = ?').get(slug);\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    \n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (!row) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return slug;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    slug = `${baseSlug}-${counter}`;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    counter++;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'export function getPublishedPosts(tag?: string): Post[] {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  let posts: any[];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (tag) {\n'[39m +

                  [32m'      SELECT p.* FROM posts p\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      JOIN post_tags pt ON p.id = pt.post_id\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      WHERE p.published = 1 AND pt.tag = ?\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    `).all(tag);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  } else {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    posts = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM posts WHERE published = 1').all();\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  return posts.map(post => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    const tagsRows = db.prepare('SELECT tag FROM post_tags WHERE post_id = ?').all(post.id) as { tag: string }[];\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    return {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      ...post,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      tags: tagsRows.map(r => r.tag)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +

                  [32m'    ...post,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    tags: tagsRows.map(r => r.tag)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  const slug = generateSlug(data.title);\n'[39m +

                  [32m'export function generateSlug(title: string, excludePostId?: number): string {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  let baseSlug = title\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    .toLowerCase()\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')\n"[39m +
                  [32m"    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  \n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (!baseSlug) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    baseSlug = 'post';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  let slug = baseSlug;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  let counter = 2;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  while (true) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const row = excludePostId \n'[39m +
                  [32m"      ? db.prepare('SELECT id FROM posts WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?').get(slug, excludePostId)\n"[39m +
                  [32m"      : db.prepare('SELECT id FROM posts WHERE slug = ?').get(slug);\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    \n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (!row) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return slug;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    slug = `${baseSlug}-${counter}`;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    counter++;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'export function getPublishedPosts(tag?: string): Post[] {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  let posts: any[];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (tag) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    posts = db.prepare(`\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      SELECT p.* FROM posts p\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      JOIN post_tags pt ON p.id = pt.post_id\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      WHERE p.published = 1 AND pt.tag = ?\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    `).all(tag);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  } else {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    posts = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM posts WHERE published = 1').all();\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  return posts.map(post => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    const tagsRows = db.prepare('SELECT tag FROM post_tags WHERE post_id = ?').all(post.id) as { tag: string }[];\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    return {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      ...post,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      tags: tagsRows.map(r => r.tag)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'export function getAllPosts(): Post[] {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"  const posts = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM posts').all() as any[];\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  return posts.map(post => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    const tagsRows = db.prepare('SELECT tag FROM post_tags WHERE post_id = ?').all(post.id) as { tag: string }[];\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    return {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      ...post,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      tags: tagsRows.map(r => r.tag)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  if (!post) return null;\n'[39m +

                  [32m'    ...post,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    tags: tagsRows.map(r => r.tag)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +

                  [32m'export function createPost(data: { title: string; body: string; tags: string[]; published: number }): Post {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const slug = generateSlug(data.title);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  \n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const insertPost = db.prepare(`\n'[39m +
